description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Wages Board for the Liquor and Vinegar Trade
categorisation: This gazette notification publishes a regulatory decision under the Wages Boards Ordinance, specifically approving and implementing new minimum wage rates for the Liquor and Vinegar Trade. It constitutes a legal/regulatory instrument that establishes compliance requirements for employers in this specific trade sector, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) for regulatory frameworks and statutory instruments.
